claims.claim: The paper reports a diffusion approach for explaining neural audio deepfake decisions.
claims.limitations: Deepfake types, explanation faithfulness, model family, and listener interpretation bound transfer.

claims.claim: The paper reports a comparison of human and neural-model responses in multitalker babble.
claims.limitations: Listeners, babble construction, vowel contrasts, training duration, and model architecture bound transfer.

claims.claim: The paper reports location-aware target-speaker extraction for hearing-aid scenarios.
claims.limitations: Array geometry, motion, layout, processing, and intelligibility metric bound transfer.

claims.claim: The paper presents a benchmark and case study for Arabic pronunciation assessment.
claims.limitations: Recitation tradition, annotation, coverage, and metrics bound transfer; automatic scores are not teacher judgment.

claims.claim: The paper reports improved disentanglement for zero-shot expressive conversion.
claims.limitations: Enrollment, labels, languages, metrics, and unseen-speaker protocol bound transfer.

claims.claim: The paper presents EmoSpeechAuth and evaluates emotion-aware speaker verification.
claims.limitations: Emotion labels, speakers, channel, enrollment, thresholds, and demographics bound transfer.

claims.claim: The paper reports EAA results for emotion-aware audio large language modeling.
claims.limitations: Labels, prompts, audio quality, model, and human agreement bound transfer.

claims.claim: The paper reports a contextual analysis of /s/ in a multilingual Nigerian setting.
claims.limitations: Community, language, sampling, annotation, and interpretation bound transfer.

claims.claim: The paper reports GTA results for generative text-to-audio retrieval.
claims.limitations: Audio, prompts, token rates, metrics, hardware, and generation budget bound transfer.
